newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B index up at noon led by Wafangdian.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B index up at noon led by Wafangdian.

text.p: Shenzhen's B index extended last week's sharp gains on Monday morning, led by a rise in Wafangdian Bearing Co, analysts said.
The foreign currency B share index gained 2.31 points or 1.28 percent to 183.41 on turnover of HK$167.4 million, after registering a year-high on both Friday and Thursday.
"Wafangdian is an attractive new stock and is pushing up the index," said an analyst at J&A Securities.
Wafangdian ended the morning at HK$7.05, soaring HK$0.64 or 9.98 percent to become the best performer. It was also the most actively traded stock on volume of 4.86 million shares.
"The price/earnings ratio (of Wafangdian) is low compared with other B shares and investors tend to favour new shares," an analyst at J&A Securities in Shenzhen said.

The company, the only firm to list on the Shenzhen B share market so far in 1997, posted earnings per share of 0.50 yuan for the January-September period of 1996, against 0.47 yuan for the whole of 1995, based on Chinese accounting standards.
"Wafangdian keeps rising because as a new share it is less constrained by technical charts," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
Analysts said they expected the B share index to rise further in the next few sessions due to favorable economic statistics released by Beijing last week.
"The strong economic figures will give a big, long upward push to the index," the Guotai analyst said.
China expects gross domestic product (GDP) growth of around 10 percent in 1997 with retail price inflation kept below five percent, the State Statistical Bureau said on Friday.
"We have not seen the end of the run," the J&A analyst said.
The A share index rose 10.36 points or 2.24 percent to 472.32 at noon on turnover of 5.27 billion yuan.
Conglomerate China Vanke Co Ltd was the most heavily traded A share, gaining 1.24 yuan or 7.52 percent to end the morning at 17.74 yuan on volume of 9.09 million shares.
